node.input: iRingRadius.GetDouble(ref radius), initialized7.0; channel conversion behavior needs full evaluator integration
node.operation: OnCircle(OnUtil.On_zx_plane,radius), GetNurbForm to OnNurbsCurve; <=0 -> UpdateError(GetNurbForm failed)
node.output: CSRingRailData(converted NURBS,radius); CSRailData.SetCurve converts to NURBS and copies nonempty user strings without explicit SetDomain

ringSize: CSValueRingSize version1.2 stores radius in mm. Major1/minor<=1 converts stored US size with ConvertFromUSToMMRadius. Do not treat all stored ring values as US sizes.

publicCorroboration.facts: Modern official World_zx has origin0, local X=world Z, local Y=world X, normal=world Y. Circle NURBS is rational quadratic with9 poles and4 quarter spans over0..2pi.
publicCorroboration.limit: Modern official source corroborates a proposed test oracle, not original Rhino5 binary/parameterization proof.

candidateHazard: Pinned OCCT default Convert_TgtThetaOver2 selects3 spans for a full circle. Explicit Convert_TgtThetaOver2_4 is available. Equal geometric locus alone does not prove compatible curve parameters; test actual domain/poles/weights/parameter samples before use.
requiredCases: ZX and translated/rotated frames, seam direction
Default/missing radius7, positive/zero/negative/nonfinite source error behavior
Quadratic rational four-span representation and non-linear parameter-to-angle samples
Legacy ring1.1 size conversion vs1.2 stored-radius units
Downstream rails/profile/loft/morph parameter behavior and original-PC comparison
scope: Audit only; no claim that the available design or its rail regenerates on iPad.
